snippet.title: DCS: MiG-29A FULCRUM
snippet.description:
A study-level, 4th generation Russian fighter has long been sought after by DCS pilots, and our MiG-29A is being developed to the highest degree of authenticity with external and cockpit models, systems, flight model, weapons, and sensors replicated to what we believe will set a high standard for DCS.

DCS e-shop: https://www.digitalcombatsimulator.com/en/shop/modules/fulcrum/
